finding_type: Uncapped Carrier Liability for Theft and Parcel Loss
summary: Party B bears all economic loss and liquidated damages arising from theft or disposal of stolen goods by its personnel, with no monetary cap or limitation of liability.
evidence_quote: Party B shall be responsible for all of Party A's economic loss and relevant liquidated damages arising out of any theft and disposal of stolen goods conducted by Party B's personnel.

summary: Party B is held solely liable for legal and economic consequences resulting from non-compliance, traffic rules breach, vehicle damage, and personnel casualties, while Party A assumes zero liability.
evidence_quote: Party B shall bear any legal liability arising out of severe traffic accidents causing vehicle damage and personnel casualties, and Party A shall have no liability.

summary: Party B must pay one month of freight as liquidated damages for early termination without consent, whereas Party A can terminate without compensation if space is insufficient.
evidence_quote: Party B shall pay one-month freight as liquidated damages in case of termination of the Agreement without consent.
